# Issue575: record the owner-authorized mixed-model review policy

Fresh Sol/Ultra documentation author, one bounded task. Work only in
`/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-575-independent-opus-reviews`,
branch `issue-575-independent-opus-reviews`, initially clean at published
`92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10`. MAIN bootstraps it before admission.
Use primary `/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/local/bin/` for workflow/GitHub reads.

Read issue575, local/protocols/meta.md, current canonical review protocol and
recent EVOLUTION format. Read the OPUS REVIEWERS section AND correction at
the end of `/tmp/qpbt-main-handoff-v5.md`. The owner's latest explicit resend
also specifies the six Mac slots are THREE FIXERS and THREE REVIEWERS.
The first batch272/288/289/299/271/274 was withdrawn in the correction; do not
re-enable Opus reviews of those Opus-modified PRs or294.

Implement a small dated amendment in `local/protocols/review.md` and append
its matching 2026-09-17 EVOLUTION entry. Scope is those two documentation files;
no runtime scripts, mathematical files, AGENTS, allocation/config/key changes,
or new enforcement mechanism. This records an existing explicit owner exception
to the normal dispatch-only workflow, not a general reactivation of old native
lease machinery, permission expansion, or a changed project goal.

The amendment must clearly record:
- Six owner-Mac helper slots (3 fixers/3 reviewers), using no ghz model key;
  no codex/dispatch/review/autofix lanes or ghz Opus runner. The current MAIN
  remains on relay-1 with one native delegate and lane caps0/0/0.
- Fresh independent reviewer per PR head, never an author/fixer of that PR;
  trusted personas/checklists from pinned published main, full diff read-only.
- Opus reviewers handle only PRs no Opus helper has changed, checked against
  owner-sessions opus-fix/opus-modernize/opus-orc provenance. The other model
  family reviews repairs; in particular Opus-modified PRs require native
  Codex independent review. Do not let another fresh Opus thread approve
  Opus-authored changes merely because its thread is different.
- Standard marked COMMENT review via primary gh_common.py post-review,
  findings ledger and final parseable VERDICT. Helpers never post commit
  statuses, edit the reviewed branch, merge or run CI as a reviewer.
- Established watchdog claims/release lines and `review <PR>` requests;
  a release names verdict, exact head and published review id.
- MAIN reads the actual published record, verifies commit binding/marker,
  final verdict and zero unchecked findings before local-review/summary
  success; adverse, missing or malformed evidence fails closed. This is
  approval for that head, not a freshness/CI/merge waiver.
- Existing section13 whitespace-sensitive diff carry remains binding after
  conflict-free refresh. A carry is not a new review round or a carry source.
  Preserve review caps, source-faithfulness and historical costs.

Use concise operational prose and links to existing rules instead of a second
copy of the whole review protocol. EVOLUTION fields: Trigger (owner decision/
resend and dated events record), Change, Expected effect; distinguish documented
operator checks from automation actually enforced by code.

Check diff whitespace, internal references and consistency with the supplied
decision; normal git hook check and commit through ordinary hooks. No new
tests mirroring prose, no full build/CI/render, no push/PR/review/status/merge.
Return the commit, changed paths, concise checks, a PR-body draft with Closes575,
and exact artifact hashes under `/tmp/qpbt-575-amendment-20260917-*`.

Budget420 seconds including final60 for commit/receipt, absolute deadline at
launch. Keep the amendment around100 lines or fewer unless clarity requires
slightly more; never exceed the workflow episode budget. If a genuine code
enforcement discrepancy appears, report it without expanding to implementation.
One task then retire; you authored this change and may not review it later.
MAIN plus one native relay-1 delegate; no descendants, other keys, lanes,
codex exec, dispatch.sh, review.sh, autofix, chsh, or local Opus runner.
